note: The two sets are nearly identical in content and share the same defects: both insert an unsupported "3"" into the bolt quote/condition (the text reads "3/4" BOLT NUT WELDED TO WIDE FLANGE" with 3" as a separate dimension), both misbind the (4) 3/4" DIA HOLES to a deck opening plate when they belong to the foundation detail, and both use stitched quotes ("3/8" FITTED STIFFENER", "16 GAUGE PLATE OF OPENING"). The only differences favor A: it correctly binds PL5x4x3/8 and the 3" std. pipe to the PV attachment detail ("PV attachment plate", "PV attachment pipe"), whereas B leaves them as vague generic "plate" and "pipe". A is therefore marginally more faithful and specific.
